records.name: Presidency University Kolkata
records.description: Presidency University Kolkata is one of India's oldest educational institutions, with origins dating to 1817 as Hindu College, and has nurtured luminaries including Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and Satyendra Nath Bose. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sciences, humanities, social sciences, and management, with particular strength in physics, chemistry, mathematics, and economics. The university holds 'A' grade accreditation from NAAC and has been conferred Institution of Eminence status.

records.name: Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC)
records.description: Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), University of Delhi, is India's most prestigious undergraduate commerce college, established in 1926 and consistently ranked first among commerce colleges nationally. It offers BCom (Hons) and BA (Hons) Economics programs known for their rigorous curriculum and exceptional placement record. SRCC alumni occupy leading positions in finance, consulting, academia, and public policy globally.

records.name: Loyola College
records.description: Loyola College Chennai, established in 1925 by the Society of Jesus (Jesuits), is one of India's most reputed autonomous colleges affiliated with the University of Madras. It is known for excellence in sciences, commerce, arts, social sciences, and visual communication, and has been accredited 'A++' by NAAC. The college is consistently ranked among the top autonomous colleges in India for holistic education and research.

records.name: St. Xaviers College
records.description: St. Xavier's College Mumbai, established in 1869 by the Jesuits and affiliated with the University of Mumbai, is one of India's oldest and most prestigious liberal arts and science colleges. It offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sciences, commerce, arts, and social sciences, and holds autonomous status with NAAC 'A' grade accreditation. The college is renowned for its rigorous academics, vibrant student life, and distinguished alumni in academia, business, and public life.

records.name: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics
records.description: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics (NMCC) Mumbai is a leading autonomous commerce college affiliated with the University of Mumbai, known for strong BCom and BMS programs. The college has consistently ranked among Mumbai's top commerce institutions and is recognized for its academic rigor, industry interface, and placement record. It offers specialized programs in commerce, economics, and management with a focus on professional readiness.

records.name: Christ University
records.description: Christ University Bangalore is a deemed university known for its high-quality education in commerce, management, science, humanities, law, and education. It is accredited 'A++' by NAAC and is particularly renowned for its BCom, MBA, and BBA programs that emphasize holistic development. Christ University has a strong placement record and is consistently ranked among India's top private universities.

records.name: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce
records.description: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce Pune is a well-regarded autonomous college affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University, known for its BA, BCom, and BBA programs. The college is part of the Symbiosis International University ecosystem and is recognized for its multicultural student environment and industry-oriented curriculum. It is accredited by NAAC and known for academic excellence and extracurricular activities.

records.name: Lady Shri Ram College for Women
records.description: Lady Shri Ram College for Women (LSR), University of Delhi, established in 1956, is India's most prestigious women's college, particularly renowned for its economics, English, and commerce programs. It has produced an exceptional number of civil servants, journalists, economists, and public figures. LSR is consistently ranked first among women's colleges in India and is NAAC 'A+' accredited.

records.name: St. Josephs College of Commerce
records.description: St. Joseph's College of Commerce Bangalore is an autonomous Jesuit institution established in 1882, affiliated with Bangalore University, and known for excellence in commerce and management education. It offers BCom, BBA, MBA, and MCom programs with a strong emphasis on ethical leadership, professional skills, and community engagement. The college holds NAAC 'A+' accreditation and consistently ranks among Karnataka's top commerce colleges.

records.name: Hans Raj College
records.description: Hans Raj College, University of Delhi, established in 1948, is one of Delhi's premier undergraduate colleges offering programs in sciences, commerce, and humanities. It is particularly known for its physics, chemistry, mathematics, and commerce departments, producing graduates who excel in academia, civil services, and industry. The college holds NAAC 'A+' accreditation and is consistently ranked among the top colleges in Delhi University.
